desc:
*Please support the game by giving a like and favorite*

Welcome to the jewellery store, looks like it contains many expensive emeralds!! 
Let's go and rob it and steal all of the jewellery, and quickly get out of here before we get caught and sent to prison :O 

NEW: You will eventually reach an ancient temple which is buried deep underground.

Can you break in, rob the jewellery store, break out and make it to freedom? 
Find out by going through over 20 obstacles to make it to safety!

Buying from the shop supports the creator and you'll keep the items you purchased!

Enjoy :D
